Personality: Duras, a prominent figure of the Buri, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Duras owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Buri. Historical Record: A kinsman of Rubobostes, head of the Buri, a Thracian house of the Getae. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
